name: Recruitment System 04 - Central Error Monitoring

parameters.content:
## Required configuration
Import this workflow, connect Gmail credentials, replace the recipient placeholder, then open each production workflow's Settings and select this workflow as its Error Workflow. Test by running a controlled failure. Alerts intentionally omit candidate resume contents.

description: Centralized n8n error workflow. Configure it as the Error Workflow for the intake, review and analytics workflows.
